title: Besicovitch density of E ⊆ M for θ·μ⌞M along closed balls, a.e. on E ∩ B_r(y)
statement:
Let P ∈ ℕ and let μ be any measure on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P) (Borel σ-algebra). Let M, E ⊆ ℝ^P be μ-null-measurable with E ⊆ M, and let θ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ > 0 on M. Let y ∈ ℝ^P and r ∈ ℝ, and suppose θ is μ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_r(y). Then for μ⌞(E ∩ B_r(y))-almost every x, as s → 0⁺ (quotient in [0, ∞]):
(∫⁻_{E∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ(z)) dμ(z)) / (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ(z)) dμ(z)) → 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (M E : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (y : Eucl P) (r : ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μ → NullMeasurableSet E μ → E ⊆ M → (∀ z ∈ M, 0 < θ z) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ closedBall y r) μ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.restrict (E ∩ ball y r)), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in E ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂μ) / (∫⁻ z in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ z) ∂μ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
